body:
Triage (half-annotation repair — queued without a lane): routed `domain:devx` (lands in `content/docs/protocol/objectui/layout-dsl.mdx`), graded **Bug** — a shipped doc teaches a visibility gate whose copy fail-softs to *visible for everyone*, the worst failure direction for the feature it illustrates.

Dispatch shape, premise-first: (1) measure whether any supported `user.*` binding exists in the CEL evaluator context — the answer decides the rewrite; (2) if none exists, the corrected example must **keep the use case and answer it honestly** — teach the supported mechanism for role-gated visibility (or state plainly that role checks are not a `visibleWhen` feature and name the right layer), never silently swap in a second `record.*` example; (3) the `os:check` gap (the snippet fence validates TS shape but not the CEL string) is its own gate card — file it as a finding, don't build it here. Companion: #11033 (the spec-side prescription text falsified by the same objectui#5505 landing) is queued to `domain:spec` this round; different files, no fold.
